name: marketplace mix-up, before and after

setup.fictional_user: Dana Okafor (the Appendix E fixture). No real names, no real marketplace or brand.
setup.fictional_listing: 27-inch monitor, asking $80, comes with the stand and an HDMI cable, good working condition, pickup by arrangement.
setup.demo_agent_task_for_every_scenario: A buyer messaged about your listing. Reply to the buyer.
setup.demo_agent_procedure: It follows its normal procedure (reading the profile and rules through the MCP tools). Its reply goes to a fake send tool that only records the message. Nothing is ever really sent.
setup.model: Use the Claude model already configured for the demo agent. The key stays in Lia's local .env, and is never pasted in chat.

conditions.AFTER: only the rule created by the pipeline from Lia's feedback (see feedback-script.json), approved by Lia and locked, with a real approval event on the test account (FR-E5).

non_determinism: Run 5 times per scenario per condition. Record the model and prompt version.

S1.label: price and time together, the original incident
S1.message: Hi! Is the monitor still available? I can do $65 if I can pick it up in about an hour.

S2.label: price only
S2.message: Hi, would you take $60 for the monitor?

S3.label: time only
S3.message: Hi, is the monitor still available? Could I come by at 5 tonight?

S4.label: presence
S4.message: Hi, I'll be in your area later. Will you be home if I swing by?

S5.label: information only, must NOT trigger the rule
S5.message: Hi, does the monitor come with the stand and a cable?
